llm_usage.sql:
CREATE TABLE llm_usage (
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ts FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	day TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	session_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	run_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	node_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT DEFAULT 'build' NOT NULL, 
	model TEXT NOT NULL, 
	effort TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	tok_in BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	tok_out BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	cache_read BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	cache_write BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	usd FLOAT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	usd_source TEXT DEFAULT 'estimated' NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'ok' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_kind_ck CHECK (kind IN ('build','chat','aux')), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_tokens_ck CHECK (tok_in >= 0 AND tok_out >= 0 AND cache_read >= 0 AND cache_write >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_usd_ck CHECK (usd >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_attempts_ck CHECK (attempts >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_usd_source_ck CHECK (usd_source IN ('gateway','estimated')), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('ok','failed'))
)

    username TEXT NOT NULL,
    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
    role TEXT DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL,
    active BOOLEAN DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
    prefs JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,
    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, display_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

conflict.sql:
CREATE TABLE "conflict" (
	session_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	rid TEXT NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	handling TEXT NOT NULL, 
	summary TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	subjects JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	detector TEXT DEFAULT 'rule' NOT NULL, 
	owner TEXT, 
	doc JSON NOT NULL, 
	asked BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	ask_rank INTEGER, 
	version BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, rid), 
	CONSTRAINT conflict_handling_ck CHECK (handling IN ('ask_user','auto_repair','round_trip','hint')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

decision.sql:
CREATE TABLE decision (
	session_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	statement TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	scope_refs JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	turn_index INTEGER DEFAULT '-1' NOT NULL, 
	superseded_by INTEGER, 
	target_rid TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	option_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	changed JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	actor TEXT DEFAULT 'user' NOT NULL, 
	ts FLOAT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, ordinal), 
	CONSTRAINT decision_kind_ck CHECK (kind IN ('caliber','naming','scope','answer','adoption','correction')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

decision_record.sql:
CREATE TABLE decision_record (
	session_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	question_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	answer JSON NOT NULL, 
	actor TEXT NOT NULL, 
	actor_role TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	authority TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	source_turn TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	affected_ids JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	supersedes TEXT, 
	revision BIGINT, 
	idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL, 
	semantic_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	rationale TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	metadata JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

kernel_event.sql:

	run_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	seq BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL,

	payload JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL,

llm_usage.sql:
CREATE TABLE llm_usage (
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ts FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	day TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	session_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	run_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	node_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT DEFAULT 'build' NOT NULL, 
	model TEXT NOT NULL, 
	effort TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	tok_in BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	tok_out BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	cache_read BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	cache_write BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	usd FLOAT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	usd_source TEXT DEFAULT 'estimated' NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'ok' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_kind_ck CHECK (kind IN ('build','chat','aux')), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_tokens_ck CHECK (tok_in >= 0 AND tok_out >= 0 AND cache_read >= 0 AND cache_write >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_usd_ck CHECK (usd >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_attempts_ck CHECK (attempts >= 1), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_usd_source_ck CHECK (usd_source IN ('gateway','estimated')), 
	CONSTRAINT llm_usage_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('ok','failed'))
)

project_memory.sql:
CREATE TABLE project_memory (

	"key" TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tier TEXT NOT NULL,

question_item.sql:
CREATE TABLE question_item (
	session_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'open' NOT NULL, 
	owner_user_id TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	audience_role TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	answer_schema JSON DEFAULT '{}' NOT NULL, 
	priority TEXT DEFAULT 'normal' NOT NULL, 
	dependencies JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	blocked_artifacts JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL, 
	source_kind TEXT DEFAULT 'manual' NOT NULL, 
	source_ref TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	doc JSON NOT NULL, 
	version BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, id), 
	CONSTRAINT question_item_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('open','assigned','blocked','answered','deferred','cancelled')), 
	CONSTRAINT question_item_priority_ck CHECK (priority IN ('blocking','high','normal','low')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

revision_record.sql:

	session_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ordinal BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	parent_id TEXT, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT NOT NULL, 
	patch_set JSON, 
	changed_ids JSON DEFAULT '[]' NOT NULL,

	actor TEXT DEFAULT 'agent' NOT NULL, 
	source_turn TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_hash TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	doc JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, id), 
	CONSTRAINT revision_record_ordinal_uq UNIQUE (session_id, ordinal), 
	CONSTRAINT revision_record_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('proposed','applied','rejected','rolled_back')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

	id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	session_id TEXT NOT NULL, 
	ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status TEXT DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL,

	error TEXT DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,

	ended_at DATETIME,

	CONSTRAINT run_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('running','suspended','done','failed')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES session (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

session.sql:
CREATE TABLE "session" (
                    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '新建会话',
                    project TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle',
                    error TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
                    state_version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    next_event_seq BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    next_run_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    next_decision_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
                    owner TEXT,
                    project_id TEXT,
                    CONSTRAINT session_status_ck CHECK (status IN (
                        'idle','queued','parsing','extracting','awaiting_answer',
                        'done','failed','stopped'))
                )
